headline: Base Fighting Shifts Across Several Fronts
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the base war spreading beyond the previously prominent sectors. Fisherman’s Row remains the busiest recorded front, with 23 ownership events in 24 hours and three in the latest two-hour window; its holdings stand eight to one for the Wardens. Deadlands is still the chief unsettled ground, divided eight Colonial bases to three Warden, with 16 daily events and sharply accelerating casualties and enlistments. Stema Landing has become a fresh point of movement, recording four events in two hours and six across the day, while its nine bases remain Colonial-held. Godcrofts has nine daily events, including one in the latest two hours, despite a complete Warden hold. Lykos Isle remains split three Warden to four Colonial, with seven daily events and continuing heavy losses, though the latest casualty pace is mixed. Farranac Coast has quieted in the immediate window but retains three daily events and a nine-to-two Colonial advantage. The great casualty fronts—Weathered Expanse, Clahstra, Stlican Shelf, and Loch Mor—show renewed or accelerating fighting without recorded base events in the latest day, making their strategic picture less settled than the ownership ledger alone suggests.
